label: B25-TRACKED-BOARD-RUNNER-SOP
title: Promote the sealed board runner into a tracked parameterized tool and update the SOP
scope: Preserve the proven fail-closed behavior while replacing task-specific hardcoded identities with an explicit manifest/config contract. Track only source scripts and fixtures, never Quartus binaries, DLLs, SOFs or raw large logs. One resource-locked GamePC window may create a fresh task-owned root solely to run PowerShell AST and byte-seal validation; no preflight, process enumeration, Quartus/JTAG or hardware command is permitted.

L0: PowerShell AST parse when pwsh is available
L1: fail-closed negative matrix for hashes, cables, process ownership, markers, cached design hash and prohibited formats

acceptance: A clean clone contains every source needed to generate and seal a task-specific runner; candidate/golden identities and commands come only from a reviewed config; dry-run/fixture tests prove no hardware command is reachable after validation failure; SOP reflects the completed T-037/T-038 path.
forbidden_regions: GamePC access other than task-owned filesystem upload plus PowerShell AST/seal validation
preflight, process enumeration, quartus_pgm, nios2-terminal, jtagconfig or jtagserver execution
validation_note: The first no-hardware window reached AST 7/7 and seal 12/12 PASS, but its local wrapper returned 1 because grep -Fqx did not strip remote CRLF. R2 passed final AST/seal; subsequent fail-closed hardening added remote path/server-file/pin validation and changed sealed bytes. One fresh r3 root is therefore authorized for the immutable final bytes. None of the three windows may execute preflight or hardware paths.
